# Saint Seiya Armor Classes and Character Analysis

Saint Seiya’s combatants are organized around the “Cloths,” a system of divine armors that amplify a warrior’s Cosmo and determine their battlefield effectiveness. Saints are divided into Bronze, Silver, and Gold ranks, with Gold Cloths being unbreakable and granting their wearers the “seventh sense,” enabling light-speed movement and overwhelming power<cite id="41"></cite>. Beyond Athena’s forces, Poseidon’s Mariners wear Scales, Hades’ Specters wear Surplices, and the gods Odin and his allies don God Robes; each class confers distinct bonuses and narrative roles<cite id="22"></cite><cite id="27"></cite><cite id="37"></cite>.

## Bronze Saints
Bronze Saints wear the weakest Cloths and are the foundation of Athena’s army. Their Cosmo mastery is at a basic level, allowing mach-1 speed and superhuman strength, and they are often the training ground for future Silver and Gold Saints<cite id="50"></cite><cite id="60"></cite>. Notable Bronze Saints include Shun Osamu (Andromeda), who later becomes a Gold Saint and wields the Andromeda God Cloth; his journey exemplifies the path from Bronze to Gold<cite id="50"></cite><cite id="62"></cite>.

## Silver Saints
Silver Saints wear stronger Cloths and attain speeds from mach 2 to 5, with tremendous physical strength. They are dispatched worldwide to fulfill Sanctuary’s missions and represent the pinnacle of Athena’s warrior concept before the Gold Saints<cite id="50"></cite><cite id="60"></cite>. Examples include Shiryu’s younger brother, Shun’ei, who fights under the Andromeda Silver Cloth and demonstrates the Silver Saints’ elite capabilities<cite id="50"></cite>.

## Gold Saints (Zodiac Cloths)
Gold Saints guard the twelve temples and wear Cloths forged under their respective constellations. They possess the seventh sense, move at light speed, and wield unbreakable armors; their mastery of Cosmo and techniques defines the series’ peak human power<cite id="20"></cite><cite id="41"></cite>. problem: 中国的艺术生就业领域长期以来较为单一，主要集中在传统艺术机构、教育部门或文创企业。随着社会的发展，艺术与科技、商业、教育等领域的边界正在模糊，为艺术生提供了更广阔的职业发展空间。然请为我调研：艺术生如何突破传统就业领域的限制，实现多元化职业发展？当前社会评价体系如何影响艺术人才的发展空间与收入水平？知识产权保护与文化消费升级能否有效提升艺术人才经济待遇？不同国家在艺术人才社会地位提升方面有哪些可借鉴的经验与模式？

## 艺术生突破传统就业领域、实现多元化职业发展的路径

艺术生的就业边界正在被数字创意、文旅融合、游戏动漫等新兴领域重塑，这些方向提供了游戏美术/特效、虚拟空间艺术、沉浸式展览等高潜力岗位，以及文旅项目策划、影视综艺美术指导等跨界机会。主动拓展技能组合、参与行业实践、打造个人品牌，是突破传统路径的关键策略<cite id="137"></cite><cite id="139"></cite><cite id="149"></cite>。

### 1. 聚焦新兴领域与高需求岗位
数字创意产业持续升温，游戏设计、智能影像、虚拟空间艺术等岗位人才缺口超过50万，相关技能（如原画、3D建模、特效设计）需求旺盛，薪资水平可达8k–2w起；VR/AR设计在虚拟展厅、AR营销等领域应用广泛，掌握Unity/UE等工具可进入高增长赛道<cite id="137"></cite><cite id="139"></cite>。文化创意产业为艺术生提供影视综艺美术指导、文旅项目策划（如灯光秀、景区IP设计）、衍生品开发等岗位，与文旅融合政策红利形成共振<cite id="137"></cite>。

### 2. 构建跨界能力与作品集
艺术与科技、商业的结合正在改变职业形态，NFT艺术、VR/AR展览、艺术IP运营（如泡泡玛特）等案例表明，掌握AIGC工具、动态捕捉、虚拟制片等技术，以及品牌联名、衍生品开发等商业能力，有助于打开新赛道<cite id="139"></cite><cite id="149"></cite>。设计类岗位需强化软件技能（AI/PS/CAD）、材料工艺知识，影视类需掌握剪辑（Premiere/DaVinci）与3D建模（Maya/ZBrush），同时培养资源整合与个人品牌运营能力<cite id="149"></cite>。

### 3. 多元就业形态与职业规划
自由职业与创业、教育疗愈、内容创作等方向为艺术生提供补充路径，独立插画师、艺术工作室主理人、自媒体艺术博主等形态值得探索；艺术治疗师、儿童美育机构创始人等教育与疗愈岗位也逐渐兴起<cite id="149"></cite>。建议在校期间积累作品集、参与行业比赛（如金马奖、金犊奖），实习选择美术馆、设计工作室、影视剧组等，中期可考虑大厂镀金后再转向全流程岗位，长期则需平衡创意与商业化，探索创业或工作室模式<cite id="149"></cite>。

### 4. 教育与政策支持的作用
艺术教育需对接产业需求，推动专业设置与课程改革，例如通过“双师型”教师培养、校企合作项目提升学生的实践能力与就业竞争力；政策层面可通过乡村振兴中的公共艺术项目、非遗传承扶持等，为艺术生创造更多实践与就业场景<cite id="129"></cite><cite id="133"></cite>。

## 当前社会评价体系对艺术人才发展与收入的影响

艺术行业的评价体系长期以市场销售与声誉为核心，但市场不确定性和信息不对称导致收入不稳定，艺术从业者常面临“低收入、高非货币回报”的结构性特征。研究显示，艺术行业的低收入在很大程度上是结构性的，补贴未必能有效提升收入，反而可能加剧“贫困艺术家”现象；同时，艺术生的就业认知长期受限于“当老师、做画家”的刻板印象，而实际就业赛道已全面拓宽，体制内、大厂、自由职业、创业、深造等方向并存<cite id="142"></cite><cite id="144"></cite><cite id="147"></cite><cite id="136"></cite>。

## 知识产权保护与文化消费升级对艺术人才经济待遇的提升作用

知识产权保护通过强化创作者权益、构建信任机制，有助于提升艺术人才的经济回报。追续权制度（艺术家就原件再次销售获取比例收益）在80多个国家实施，可缓解艺术品拍卖市场中“首次售出即获全部经济利益”的悬殊，鼓励创作并平衡利益分配；在电商与数字艺术领域，版权保护机制、信用评价体系、平台介入保障等多元信任机制，有助于解决真伪鉴定与品质保障难题，提升交易透明度与创作者收益<cite id="148"></cite><cite id="145"></cite><cite id="147"></cite>。

文化消费升级扩大了艺术市场的规模与需求，但同时也带来价值评估体系失衡、数字艺术品版权保护困难、线上交易信任机制不完善等问题。通过区块链构建全链条管理模式、打造沉浸式虚拟展览与线上线下融合体验、创新数字化交易与金融化模式、培育数字艺术生态等策略，可推动市场转型升级，为艺术人才创造更多变现场景与收入来源<cite id="149"></cite>。

## 国际经验与可借鉴模式

多个国家通过制度设计与政策支持提升艺术人才的社会地位与经济待遇。欧洲议会报告梳理了改善作者与表演者经济状况的措施，涵盖个体劳动关系、专业代表、社会保障、税收与跨国流动等维度，为统一行动提供框架<cite id="147"></cite>。国际劳工组织分析了艺术文化领域的雇佣关系，强调社会保障与劳动权益保障对从业者稳定性的基础作用<cite id="146"></cite>。

法国的追续权制度是艺术创作国家赞助衰弱背景下的产物，通过分流艺术商收益、鼓励创作与名声增值，提升艺术家长期经济回报；荷兰的“艺术家工作室补贴”与“公共工程计划”则直接改善创作条件与就业机会，增强社会支持网络<cite id="148"></cite><cite id="144"></cite>。北欧国家通过全民基本收入、艺术教育振兴、工作室补贴等组合政策，为艺术家提供基本保障与发展资源，值得借鉴<cite id="144"></cite>。

## 结论与建议

艺术生应主动拥抱跨界融合，将技术工具、商业思维与个人创作结合，拓展数字创意、文旅融合、游戏动漫等新兴赛道，同时构建作品集与个人品牌，提升市场竞争力。教育机构需对接产业需求，强化实践教学与校企合作；政策层面可通过知识产权保护、文化消费升级、社会保障与补贴等组合措施，改善艺术人才的经济待遇与社会地位。国际经验表明，制度保障、社会支持与市场机制的协同，是提升艺术人才发展空间与收入水平的关键路径<cite id="137"></cite><cite id="139"></cite><cite id="149"></cite><cite id="142"></cite><cite id="144"></cite><cite id="147"></cite><cite id="148"></cite>.

<search query="知识产权保护 艺术人才 收入 文化消费升级 艺术品市场 艺术品版权 艺术品消费" search_time="2026年5月16日12时47分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:145"><title>美术作品追续权制度实证研究——从精神权利视角看美术作品保护</title><summary>追续权是著作权中一项权能，属于法学的研究范畴，但毫无疑问与之最密切相关的不是法学家，而是艺术家。尤其是随着近几年中国艺术品市场的聚集度与关注度的急速上升，艺术品拍卖价格一再飙升，远远超过艺术家首次转移作品所有权及著作权时获得的经济利益。这种现象几乎是艺术品市场所特有的价格与价值背离的体现，尽管并未违反自愿交易的基本原则，但其不符合经济学中的一般规律。同时，追续权入法仍然是国际趋势。本文以著作权精神权利为视角，并借鉴欧盟和美国的立法经验，探讨追续权保利益平衡、消除利益悬殊的功能，为实现著作权法的价值目标提供参考。</summary><hostname>CORE</hostname><publisher>美术学报</publisher><author_list><author name="朱一青" /></author_list><url>https://core.ac.uk/download/pdf/41436125.pdf</url></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:146"><title>Crypto Art: NFT Art Trading and the Art Market</title><summary>This article introduces what NFT art is and what virtual art trading is and analyses the advantages, disadvantages, and current status of NFT art. It also discusses how NFT artworks have changed the trend and demand in the art market.</summary><hostname>ResearchGate</hostname><publisher>Asian Journal of Social Science Studies</publisher><author_list><author name="Shuyu Wang" affiliation="The University of New South Wales, Sydney, Australia" /></author_list><url>https://www.researchgate.net/publication/365367573_Crypto_Art_NFT_Art_Trading_and_the_Art_Market/fulltext/637279fc2f4bca7fd05da256/Crypto-Art-NFT-Art-Trading-and-the-Art-Market.pdf</url><publish_time>2022年11月14日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:147"><title>中国油画艺术品电商的本土化创新研究——以深圳“大芬村”为例</title><summary>本文以深圳大芬油画村为案例，深入探讨中国油画艺术品电商在发展过程中的本土化创新路径与机制。研究发现，大芬村通过商业模式重构、营销方式创新与技术融合应用等多维度本土化创新策略，实现了从传统“行画”生产基地向原创油画电商集群的转型。大芬村积极应对艺术品电商特有的真伪鉴定难、品质保障难等信任难题，构建了以版权保护机制、信用评价体系、平台介入保障为核心的多元信任机制。大芬村的实践经验表明，本土化创新是中国油画电商发展的关键动力，其经验为中国油画电商产业的转型升级提供了有益参考。</summary><publisher>电子商务评论</publisher><author_list><author name="张蕾" affiliation="江苏大学艺术学院，江苏 镇江" /><author name="庄融" affiliation="School of Art, Jiangsu University, Zhenjiang Jiangsu" /></author_list><url>https://pdf.hanspub.org/ecl_2317480.pdf</url><publish_time>2025年12月25日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:148"><title>论追续权制度在我国的构建——以《著作权法》第三次修改为中心</title><summary>追续权是艺术家及其继承人就其艺术品原件的再次销售获取一定比例收益的权利。这一制度源于法国，是艺术创作国家赞助体系衰弱的产物。追续权制度的正当性基础在于鼓励创作，以及作者名声的提高导致艺术品的增值。追续权制度具有鼓励艺术创作、丰富艺术市场的生产性功能，也具有对艺术商所获得的转售艺术品原件的收益进行分流的结构性功能。客体、主体、计算基础及比例、适用的场合构成了追续权制度的内部法律构造；知情权与集体管理制度构成了追续权制度的外部法律构造。比较法上的实证数据表明，追续权制度不会对艺术品拍卖市场造成扭曲。目前世界上80多个国家规定追续权制度。从我国目前的艺术品拍卖市场前景看，我国著作权法实有引进该制度之必要。</summary><hostname>为你创业网</hostname><publisher>法律科学(西北政法大学学报)</publisher><author_list><author name="李雨峰" affiliation="西南政法大学民商法学院" /></author_list><url>http://www.wncyip.com/UploadFiles/20190107/20190107145536695.pdf</url></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:149"><title>数字经济时代艺术品市场商业模式创新与艺术价值传递策略探究</title><summary>数字技术深刻改变了艺术品的创作、展示与交易,对传统商业模式产生了显著影响。在数字经济背景下,如何推进商业模式创新并确保艺术价值有效传递,成为艺术品市场亟待解决的问题。数字技术拓展了艺术品传播范围,提升交易效率与透明度,激发了创作新活力,促进了市场多元化发展。然而,艺术品市场也面临诸多问题,如艺术价值评估体系失衡、数字艺术品版权保护困难、线上交易信任机制不完善、技术应用与艺术本质割裂以及传统从业者转型困难等。文章针对这些问题,提出以下策略:利用区块链技术构建艺术品全链条管理模式,确保信息透明与版权保护;打造沉浸式虚拟展览与线上线下融合体验模式,丰富艺术体验;创新艺术品数字化交易与金融化模式,降低投资门槛;建立基于大数据的艺术价值发现与精准营销模式,提升艺术价值传递效率;培育数字艺术创作生态与新型艺术家孵化模式,推动数字艺术发展。研究发现,数字经济时代的到来给艺术品市场带来变革契机与挑战,商业模式创新是顺应发展的必然路径,艺术价值有效传递是市场发展的核心导向。文章指出,通过实施上述策略,可推动艺术品市场在数字时代实现转型升级,助力市场持续繁荣,为文化传承与艺术创新提供持久动力。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>《艺术科技》</publisher><author_list><author name="杨方迪[1]" /><author name="李繁叶[2]" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7201708466</url><publish_time>2025年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document>
</search>

<fetch fetch_id="baa4254e-f849-4b22-b9a2-724dd4b9c938"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:149"><url>https://liuxue.xdf.cn/blog/blog_7591608.shtml</url><title>艺术类专业选择与职业发展指南</title><pagination_content start_offset="0" end_offset="2730">### 武捷

艺术类专业涵盖视觉艺术、表演艺术、设计、音乐、影视等多个领域，既有传统技艺的传承，也有与科技、商业结合的创新方向。选择艺术类专业需要结合个人天赋、兴趣与市场需求，同时明确职业发展的多元路径。以下是为艺术类学生提供的专业选择与职业发展指南：

### 一、艺术类专业核心方向

#### 1. 视觉艺术类

- **细分方向** ：油画、国画、雕塑、版画、实验艺术

- **适合人群** ：热爱传统或当代艺术创作，具备较强的造型能力和美学修养。

- **职业路径** ：职业艺术家、美术馆策展人、艺术教育、艺术品鉴定。

- **趋势建议** ：

    - 当代艺术更关注跨界表达（如装置艺术、数字艺术）。

    - 商业结合：艺术衍生品开发、公共艺术项目。

#### 2. 设计类

- **细分方向** ：

    - **平面设计** ：品牌视觉、包装设计、UI/UX设计。

    - **空间设计** ：室内设计、景观设计、展览设计。

    - **时尚设计** ：服装设计、配饰设计、纺织品设计。

- **适合人群** ：创意能力强，对视觉传达或空间构造敏感。

- **职业路径** ：设计师、设计总监、自由设计师、设计教育。

- **趋势建议** ：

    - 掌握3D建模（Blender/C4D）、AIGC工具（如MidJourney辅助设计）。

    - 可持续设计（环保材料、低碳理念）是行业热点。

#### 3. 表演艺术类

- **细分方向** ：戏剧表演、舞蹈、音乐剧、戏曲。

- **适合人群** ：舞台表现力强，具备形体或声乐基础。

- **职业路径** ：演员、舞蹈编导、戏剧教师、演出策划。

- **趋势建议** ：

    - 多栖发展（如演员转型短视频内容创作）。

    - 参与沉浸式戏剧、虚拟偶像等新兴领域。

#### 4. 影视与动画类

- **细分方向** ：电影导演、动画制作、影视特效、游戏美术。

- **适合人群** ：擅长视觉叙事，熟悉影视工业化流程。

- **职业路径** ：导演、动画师、分镜师、影视后期。

- **趋势建议** ：

    - 学习虚拟制片（Unreal Engine）、动态捕捉技术。

    - 国产动画、游戏出海需求旺盛。

#### 5. 音乐类

- **细分方向** ：声乐、器乐、作曲、音乐制作、音乐治疗。

- **适合人群** ：具备音乐天赋或扎实理论基础。

- **职业路径** ：演奏家、音乐制作人、音乐教育、影视配乐。

- **趋势建议** ：

    - 电子音乐制作（Ableton Live）、短视频配乐是就业风口。

    - 音乐与科技结合（如AI作曲、交互式音乐装置）。

### 二、艺术类职业发展核心能力

1. **专业硬技能**

    - 视觉艺术：手绘功底、数字绘画（Procreate/Photoshop）。

    - 设计类：软件技能（AI/PS/CAD）、材料工艺知识。

    - 影视类：剪辑（Premiere/DaVinci）、3D建模（Maya/ZBrush）。

2. **跨界融合能力**

    - 艺术+科技：如NFT艺术、VR艺术展览。

    - 艺术+商业：品牌联名、艺术IP运营（如泡泡玛特）。

3. **软技能**

    - **资源整合** ：艺术家需擅长个人品牌打造（社交媒体运营）。

    - **抗挫能力** ：艺术行业竞争激烈，需面对频繁的试错与改稿。

### 三、高潜力就业方向

1. **数字艺术领域**

    - 游戏美术（原画/3D建模）、元宇宙场景设计、NFT创作者。

2. **文化创意产业**

    - 影视综艺美术指导、文旅项目策划（如灯光秀、景区IP设计）。

3. **教育与疗愈**

    - 艺术治疗师、儿童美育机构创始人。

4.
    - 独立插画师、艺术工作室主理人、自媒体艺术博主。

### 四、职业规划建议

- **早期** （在校期间）：

    - 积累作品集，参与行业比赛（如金马奖、金犊奖）。

    - 实习选择：美术馆、设计工作室、影视剧组。

- **中期** （3-5年经验）：

- **长期** ：

    - 艺术创业需平衡创意与商业化（如开设画廊、设计品牌）。

### 五、避坑提醒

- **避免“闭门造车”** ：艺术需要市场验证，多接触行业需求。

- **谨慎选择“纯艺术”** ：职业艺术家需极强天赋与资源，建议结合商业设计保底。

- **关注政策红利** ：如乡村振兴中的公共艺术项目、非遗传承扶持。

reference_id="<|superscript|>:65"><title>二氨基烷烃功能化氧化石墨烯作为模拟油气井酸化环境中碳钢腐蚀的缓蚀剂</title><summary>在环境和高温下使用实验失重和电化学测量来评估二氨基癸烷官能化氧化石墨烯（DAD-GO）和二氨基十二烷官能化氧化石墨烯（DADD-GO）对15.0%盐酸碳钢腐蚀的腐蚀抑制效果，模拟油气井中的酸化环境。GO由废石墨制成，然后与二氨基烷烃（DAD和DADD）接枝。使用 FTIR、拉曼、TEM 和 TGA 描述了 GO 和功能化 GO。还研究了浓度和温度对抑制剂性能的影响。在室温下，抑制效率随浓度的增加而增加，在浓度为5 ppm时，DAD-GO的抑制效率最高为84%，DADD-GO的抑制效率最高为78%。在所研究的温度下，抑制剂在极低的浓度下表现良好;然而，随着温度的升高，抑制剂的性能会降低。根据PDP测量，抑制剂主要作为混合型抑制剂起作用。发现朗缪尔吸附理论之后是所研究的化合物。钢表面的AFM、SEM、EDX和FTIR表征表明，功能化的GOs分子吸附在钢上形成一层保护层，在浸泡时间（24小时）后，钢免受腐蚀性酸的侵袭。DFT计算用于确定官能化GO与GO的相对稳定性，并进一步了解抑制剂分子与钢表面的相互作用。DFT计算结果证实了实验结果。这项研究对于解决两个重要的环境问题很重要：腐蚀和废物管理，因为GO是由废石墨制成的。（c） reference_id="<|superscript|>:66"><title>钢筋绿色缓蚀剂苯磺酸及其衍生物信息理论筛选</title><summary>寻找生物毒性低而又缓蚀效果强的舰船钢筋绿色有机缓蚀剂依然是一个还未解决的难题。通过密度泛函方法结合信息理论对苯磺酸（bhs）及其22种取代衍生物建模优化，通过计算4种常用的原子信息指数如申农熵、费歇尔熵、二级费歇尔熵、parr熵值，得到了22种衍生物中s原子信息熵和缓蚀率（ei，%）以及生物半致死量（ld₅₀）之间相关性方程，从两条线性方程的交点筛选出生物毒性低而又缓蚀效果强的绿色有机缓蚀剂3-胺基苯磺酸。同时还通过模拟交点处3-胺基苯磺酸分子的红外光谱（ir）、拉曼光谱（raman）、紫外-可见光谱（uv-vis）、核磁谱图（¹h-nmr，¹³c-nmr）对筛选出的最佳取代3-胺基苯磺酸进行了光谱学指认。结果显示，苯磺酸及其22种衍生物的s原子的申农熵（sₛ）、费歇尔熵（i_f）、parr熵（gₛ）对其生物毒性和缓蚀效果变化不敏感，而s原子的二级费歇尔熵（i_f'）变化则较为明显，其中s原子的二级费歇尔熵与其ld₅₀值和ei值的线性关系最好（r²=0.98）。这对绿色缓蚀剂筛选苯磺酸衍生物的光谱以及构效关系提供了基础数据。也为武警海警学院依靠先进的虚拟仿真实验教学平台提供了丰富灵活的教学素材。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>当代化工</publisher><author_list><author reference_id="<|superscript|>:68"><title>杂环化合物与表面活性剂复配在甲醇/甲酸介质中的缓蚀作用</title><summary>目前石油和天然气管道中广泛使用q235碳钢，通常使用环境中含有有机酸腐蚀性物质（如甲酸、醋酸等），会造成严重的腐蚀，对管道安全影响很大。此外，随着绿色能源的兴起，甲醇燃料已成为了标准的石油替代品之一。大量的甲醇燃料已经被使用在工业生产、生活的过程中来减少石油的开发和利用。其中，小分子有机酸甲酸也不可避免地进入甲醇燃料中从而引起的腐蚀问题。因此，防治腐蚀刻不容缓。为了克服这个问题，通常使用缓蚀剂来阻止腐蚀情况的发生。
本文研究了以咪唑衍生物（1-十二烷基-3-甲基咪唑氯盐（dmic））、吡啶衍生物（十二烷基氯化吡啶（dpc）、十六烷基氯化吡啶（hdpc））和松香基氨基酸表面活性剂（6-das）为基础的单独有机化合物在10 mol·L⁻¹甲醇/0.1 mol·L⁻¹甲酸介质中对Q235钢的防腐蚀性能。其次，重点研究了低浓度DMIC、DPC和HDPC与6-DAS的新型复配体系对Q235钢的防腐蚀能力。利用失重测量和电化学技术（如极化曲线法（PDP）和电化学阻抗谱（EIS））评价单独体系与复配体系的防腐蚀性能。采用接触角测试、原子力显微镜（AFM）、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、能量色散X射线能谱（EDX）、拉曼光谱（Raman）及X射线光电子能谱（XPS）研究了Q235钢样品表面的形貌和组成。此外，采用等温吸附模型研究了单独缓蚀剂分子的吸附行为。最后通过量子化学计算和分子动力学模拟来说明抗腐蚀机理。主要实验结果如下：
（1）静态失重法和电化学测试结果表明：杂化物DMIC、DPC及HDPC浓度为6×10⁻² mol·L⁻¹时，防腐蚀性能最佳。此浓度下，相应的缓蚀率分别为88.81%、90.97%和92.07%。当6-DAS浓度为1×10⁻² mol·L⁻¹时，缓蚀率可达92.23%，与其他三种缓蚀剂相比，6-DAS 使用量更小，所以四种缓蚀剂的防腐蚀能力顺序应为：6-DAS＞HDPC＞DPC＞DMIC。此外，所研究的四种单一缓蚀剂均符合Langmuir等温式，是混合吸附（物理和化学吸附同时作用）的结果。而复配体系中固定6-DAS 的浓度为1×10⁻³ mol·L⁻¹，不同浓度比（1:1、1:2、1:4及1:8）的6-DAS-DMIC、6-DAS-DPC和6-DAS-HDPC三种复配缓蚀剂的缓蚀率均在90%以上。此外，四种单独缓蚀剂与复配缓蚀剂均为阳极抑制为主的混合型抗腐蚀剂。
（2）表面分析表明：经过缓蚀剂处理后的金属表面均比未添加缓蚀剂浸泡后金属表面平整，其中，6-DAS-HDPC缓蚀剂浸泡后的碳钢表面最为光滑。同时，浸泡前后碳钢表面的元素变化证明四种单独缓蚀剂与复配缓蚀剂均能很好的吸附在金属表</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>内蒙古科技大学</publisher><author_list><author name="王佳" affiliation="内蒙古科技大学" /></author_list><url>https://www.cqvip.com/doc/degree/2432178536</url><publish_time>2022年6月7日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:69"><title>Corrosion inhibition of mild steel in acidic medium by simple azole-based aromatic compounds</title><summary>Many organic corrosion inhibitors are complex and may include complicated chemical structures,

背景与问题意识： 爵士钢琴，作为爵士乐的核心组成部分之一，具有独特的演奏技法与即兴创作特性。自20世纪初以来，爵士钢琴从黑色音律的诞生到今各个流派的发展，经历了多次艺术风格的革命与变迁。特别是在现代音乐创作大潮中（尤其是1950年之后），爵士钢琴不仅深受传统爵士乐风格的影响，还不断受到其他音乐流派、比如古典音乐、摇滚乐、电音等风格的冲击和融合。然而，目前对于爵士钢琴在多元化音乐背景下的创新路径与风格演变的系统性研究仍显不足。 随着全球化和音乐的跨界发展，爵士钢琴的演奏和创作不断面临着新的挑战与机会。不同文化背景下的钢琴家在演奏技法、节奏变奏、和声结构等方面的探索，使得爵士钢琴的创作呈现多样性，而这一变化趋势值得深入剖析。
 本调研旨在探讨爵士钢琴在现代音乐创作中的创新与风格演变。通过对比分析各种创新实践及其对爵士钢琴艺术演变的推动作用，本篇调研将着重分析以下几个方面：一是爵士钢琴从经典爵士到现代爵士的风格演变；二是当代跨流派合作对爵士钢琴的艺术影响；三是技术创新（如音效处理、电子音乐的结合等）和即兴创作手法的革新对爵士钢琴艺术发展的推动。 此项调研将结合数以百计的现代演出视频、音乐创作数据以及关键演奏家访谈，构建一个多层次的分析框架，帮助阐明爵士钢琴在全球音乐创作背景下的持续创新与风格演变，更为理论和创作实践提供深入的分析视角。

This transformation is an accumulation over time of styles, methods, and techniques. During the 1950s and 1960s, electronic music gradually left the confines of the institution and migrated into the hands of independent musicians. Among the early explorers were jazz musicians who laid a foundation of experiment for later musicians to model and emulate. This article discusses two types of such experiments: (1) Jazz incorporating prerecorded electronic music on tape (1960–1970) and (2) Jazz using live electronics other than synthesizers (early years from 1965–1970). A discography is provided.</summary><hostname>Academia.edu</hostname><publisher>Jazz Perspectives</publisher><author_list><author name="Thom Holmes" affiliation="Independent Music Historian" /></author_list><url>https://www.academia.edu/download/55545210/The_Roots_of_Electronic_Jazz_1950_1970.pdf</url><publish_time>2018年1月10日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:18"><title>Making the weather in contemporary jazz: an appreciation of the musical art of Josef Zawinul</title><summary>Josef Zawinul (1932-2007) holds a rare place in the world of jazz in view of the fact that as a European he forged a long and distinguished musical career in America. Indeed, from a position of relative obscurity when he arrived in New York in 1959, he went on to become one of contemporary jazz's most prolific and commercially successful composers. The main focus of this dissertation will be Zawinul's rise to prominence in American jazz during the 1960s and 1970s. In this vital period of his creative life he is associated with a variety of jazz contexts: performing with Julian 'Cannonball' Adderley's band as a hard bop pianist in the early 1960s; developing new approaches as a composer and keyboard player for Adderley's group during the'soul jazz' period (1966 to 1969); recording independently under his own name (1966 to 1970); collaborating with Miles Davis in the late 1960s and early 1970s; and co-founding the influential contemporary jazz ensemble Weather Report (early 1970s onwards). Most significantly, he was a key figure (both as a performer and composer) in the new electro-acoustic jazz that emerged in the mid-1960s and his unwavering commitment to this hybrid idiom has left a substantial and wide-ranging body of work. Given the impact and scale of Zawinul's contribution to contemporary jazz in the second half of the twentieth century, it surely prompts the question: why has there been a dearth of scholarly discussion concerning his artistic legacy? With the aim of rectifying this omission, it is hoped that this dissertation will therefore go some way towards bringing long overdue critical engagement with his music. To this end, this study will examine a selection of Zawinul's mature works and attempt to explicate not only the diverse range of influences (musical and cultural) that were essential to his artistic development but also the nature of his aesthetic eclecticism from which he created an individual compositional language.</summary><hostname>PDF Drive</hostname><publisher>Degree Thesis</publisher><author_list><author name="Alan Cooper" affiliation="University of Southampton, School of Humanities: Music" /></author_list><url>https://www.pdfdrive.com/download.pdf?id=105344940&h=039bb43b5d39fa43b7d445df24657f27&u=cache&ext=pdf<

Centuries of development in techniques, education, culture and practice are in danger of being rendered obsolete. Changing practices for musicians raise philosophical arguments touching on the meaning of the musical work, authenticity and genre itself. This research project is a creative practice-led exercise in applying digital audio technology within the restraints of jazz as a genre. Recordings of works including harmonic, rhythmic and timbral characteristics typical to a broad definition of jazz, have been manipulated digitally with synthesis, looping and sampling. Results have indicated the importance of the timbral voice in signifying genre but the creative application of harmonic and rhythmic factors can allow new timbres to express generically. The success of the hybrid approach to the music also lies in the definitions used to describe the basic comparative criteria, which are themselves contestable. <search query="爵士钢琴 跨流派合作 现代爵士钢琴 融合 融合爵士 跨界合作 钢琴家" search_time="2026年5月16日12时50分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:31"><title>凯斯·杰瑞爵士钢琴表演艺术——以多声部演奏技法为例</title><summary>凯斯·杰瑞被公认为最富有创造力的爵士音乐家代表之一，他的即兴演奏水平使他一直以来备受爵士乐坛的瞩目。凯斯·杰瑞将他的才华与对音乐的热爱展现得淋漓尽致，他演奏出的音乐内容以及他所体现的爵士钢琴表演艺术，使他成为爵士钢琴领域中优秀且杰出的爵士钢琴演奏家。
凯斯·杰瑞呈现出的具有感染力的爵士钢琴即兴演奏令听众们叹为观止，通过对其表演艺术特征和演奏手法的分析与理解，可以为爵士钢琴学习者和研究者对于即兴演奏的学习提供有意义的借鉴，对我国爵士钢琴演奏的发展起到积极的促进作用。与此同时，凯斯·杰瑞的演奏中透露着不同于其他爵士乐演奏家的独特风格，复杂的多声部演奏技法和触键技巧是他的即兴演奏特色，而情感的深刻表达便是他演奏中不断强调的宗旨。无论诠释着哪种风格的音乐，凯斯·杰瑞总是流露着朴素、纯粹与美好的情感与如同弦乐一般的歌唱性，这种特性使他的演奏在爵士乐的历史进程发展中脱引而出，拥有着不可忽略的意义，都值得我们探索与研究；并且在演奏的过程中结合凯斯·杰瑞的演奏技法和表演艺术，呈现出的音乐能够具有更强烈的表现力和欣赏价值。
此次，笔者将从爵士钢琴演奏家凯斯·杰瑞的爵士钢琴中的双手即兴多声部演奏技法、中音声部旋律演奏技法、钢琴触键技法三个维度出发，着重于解析他在舞台演奏时运用的多声部演奏手法和对于触键的处理这几个方面的内容；本文也将从其演奏家生平经历的角度来解析其形成这种表演艺术的外在环境因素。希望通过这样的分析，将爵士钢琴演奏家凯斯·杰瑞在爵士音乐中的造诣多重维度地展示出来，并且通过笔者对于演奏家即兴演奏技巧的实践，能够合理且具体地展现演奏技巧的运用过程和效果，继而对于爵士钢琴演奏家凯斯·杰瑞的演奏技巧做到更加直观的学习、借鉴与研究。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>上海音乐学院</publisher><author_list><author name="董赫" affiliation="上海音乐学院" /></author_list><url>https://www.cqvip.com/doc/degree/3294246414</url><publish_time>2023年6月7日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:32"><title>爵士钢琴传奇——奇克·柯瑞亚的个人演奏风格特点</title><summary>奇克·柯瑞亚（chick Corea）是爵士乐史上的重要人物，他的作品介于几种爵士乐风格的边界，从传统爵士乐（Traditional Jazz）到现代爵士乐（Modern Jazz），柯瑞亚的演奏风格不断丰富，其中一些爵士乐风格是由于他的探索和实验而出现的。柯瑞亚的大胆与创新精神对于爵士音乐的发展有着很大的帮助，他的个人风格影响了20世纪下半叶爵士钢琴的形成和发展，并启发了许多当代爵士音乐家。对演奏者音乐语言特征的研究，将使人们更深入地了解当时爵士乐发生的过程。</summary><hostname>维普网</hostname><publisher>当代音乐2024年第10月号</publisher><author_list><author name="哈金伦" affiliation="俄罗斯拉赫玛尼诺夫国立音乐学院" /></author_list><url>http://m.qikan.cqvip.com/Article/ArticleDetail?id=7113088946</url><publish_time>2024年10月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:33"><title>THE HISTORY AND DEVELOPMENT OF JAZZ PIANO: A NEW PERSPECTIVE FOR EDUCATORS</title><hostname>CORE</hostname><publisher>ScholarWorks@UMass Amherst</publisher><author_list><author name="William E Taylor" affiliation="University of Massachusetts Amherst" /></author_list><url>https://core.ac.uk/download/pdf/220126064.pdf</url><publish_time>1975年8月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:34"><title>Towards New Forms of Pianistic Improvisation Across Musical Boundaries</title><summary>This thesis is practice-based. raw_output.raw_text: <search query="爵士钢琴 音色处理 音效 现代爵士钢琴 电子音乐 融合" search_time="2026年5月16日12时50分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:36"><title>Pushing the Boundaries: Digital Impacts upon Jazz</title><summary>The rapid development of audio technology, particularly in the last fifty years, has changed the way music is composed, produced, consumed and received. The domination of the traditional meta-genres, classical, jazz and folk, is increasingly challenged by postmodern thinking and new methodologies. Centuries of development in techniques, education, culture and practice are in danger of being rendered obsolete. Changing practices for musicians raise philosophical arguments touching on the meaning of the musical work, authenticity and genre itself. This research project is a creative practice-led exercise in applying digital audio technology within the restraints of jazz as a genre. Recordings of works including harmonic, rhythmic and timbral characteristics typical to a broad definition of jazz, have been manipulated digitally with synthesis, looping and sampling. Results have indicated the importance of the timbral voice in signifying genre but the creative application of harmonic and rhythmic factors can allow new timbres to express generically. The success of the hybrid approach to the music also lies in the definitions used to describe the basic comparative criteria, which are themselves contestable. Philosophical considerations can open space for new timbres, new ways to contextualise, and new ways for musicians to interact and improvise against the language of genre.</summary><hostname>Western Sydney University ResearchDirect</hostname><publisher>Degree Thesis</publisher><author_list><author name="Simon Gooden" affiliation="SCHOOL OF HUMANITIES AND COMMUNICATION ARTS, WESTERN SYDNEY UNIVERSITY" /></author_list><url>https://researchdirect.westernsydney.edu.au/islandora/object/uws%3A58981/datastream/PDF/download/citation.pdf</url><publish_time>2019年12月22日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:37"><title>THE HISTORY AND DEVELOPMENT OF JAZZ PIANO: A NEW PERSPECTIVE FOR EDUCATORS</title><hostname>CORE</hostname><publisher>ScholarWorks@UMass Amherst</publisher><author_list><author name="William E Taylor" affiliation="University of Massachusetts Amherst" /></author_list><url>https://core.ac.uk/download/pdf/220126064.pdf</url><publish_time>1975年8月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:38"><title>Pintures PIANO TEXTURES: HOW CAN I USE THE SONIC POSSIBILITIES OF THE GRAND PIANO BEING PROCESSED BY EXTERNAL EFFECTS IN ORDER TO ENHANCE MY IDIOM?</title><summary>As a pianist drawn into the world of both electronic as jazz music I had the necessity to develop a better understanding of how effect units influenced my playing. In this research I tried to answer the question: How can I use the sonic possibilities of the grand piano being processed by external effects in order to enhance my idiom? To answer this question I came up with 3 different experiments: 1. An experiment with 3 fixed audio files (a chord, 4 sixteenth notes and an repeated interval covering the full register) and all useful effect units of Ableton Live, providing an overview of the possibilities 2. An experiment where I tried to enhance my compositions characters and atmospheres with effect units, based on the recommendations of experiment 1. 3. An experiment where I tested all the effect units while improvising. Through these experiments I gained better insights in how these sonic possibilities exactly influenced my idiom. In general you can state that the effect units where successfully used to enhance my compositional characters and that, when improvising, effect units dictate the character of the improvisation instead of enhancing it. This research is useful for people who want to have a better understanding of how Ableton’s audio effects work when combined with an acoustic audio source and to have a better overview of its possibilities.</summary><hostname>c7771ce1-d363-485b-be2a-136204d4bf04.filesusr.com</

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="爵士钢琴 创新 即兴 算法 即兴生成 现代爵士钢琴" search_time="2026年5月16日12时50分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:51"><title>A Melody Description System for Jazz Improvisation</title><summary>This thesis describes a program which embodies several computational aspects of music improvisation and composition. Given an initial melody and harmonic outline, the program produces a single voice of improvisation. While the improvisation is intended to resemble a jazz (e.g. "swing" or "bebop") solo, the program's descriptive techniques reflect computational elements common to a range of tonal music. Nevertheless, the 1970s and early 1980s were a period of enormous commercial success for Hancock, starting with the 1974 Head Hunters album, which became the first jazz album to achieve platinum sales,¹ and culminating in his massive techno hit “Rockit” in 1983, which was a chart success both in the United States and the United Kingdom. The harmonic and rhythmic innovations that he made with his acoustic piano work across the 1960s² were distilled in his Rhodes playing into an instantly recognisable style that is arguably more harmonically and rhythmically advanced than that of any other player of this instrument. One of the key features of the jazz-funk genre in which the majority of these solos were performed is the generally slow rate of harmonic rhythm. Unlike the rapid chord changes of bebop and other previously prevalent jazz genres, jazz-funk was often riff-based, with improvisations based on a few chords, or often just over a single harmonic area. What set Hancock apart as a soloist within this style of improvisation was his genius for reharmonisation. With some of Hancock’s most innovative work recorded in funk and vocal pop contexts, some of which can sound dated to modern ears, a substantial degree of this innovation has gone unrecognised. The Rhodes Years Although his first recorded appearance on Fender Rhodes was the track “Stuff” on the Miles Davis Quintet album, Miles in the Sky, recorded May 17, 1968, Hancock’s first experience with an electric piano was actually some months earlier on a Wurlitzer model, of which he said: We were doing a recording session with Miles and when I came into the studio I didn’t see an acoustic piano anywhere. 调研问题：爵士钢琴在现代音乐创作中的创新与风格演变研究 
背景与问题意识： 爵士钢琴，作为爵士乐的核心组成部分之一，具有独特的演奏技法与即兴创作特性。自20世纪初以来，爵士钢琴从黑色音律的诞生到今各个流派的发展，经历了多次艺术风格的革命与变迁。特别是在现代音乐创作大潮中（尤其是1950年之后），爵士钢琴不仅深受传统爵士乐风格的影响，还不断受到其他音乐流派、比如古典音乐、摇滚乐、电音等风格的冲击和融合。然而，目前对于爵士钢琴在多元化音乐背景下的创新路径与风格演变的系统性研究仍显不足。 随着全球化和音乐的跨界发展，爵士钢琴的演奏和创作不断面临着新的挑战与机会。不同文化背景下的钢琴家在演奏技法、节奏变奏、和声结构等方面的探索，使得爵士钢琴的创作呈现多样性，而这一变化趋势值得深入剖析。
 本调研旨在探讨爵士钢琴在现代音乐创作中的创新与风格演变。通过对比分析各种创新实践及其对爵士钢琴艺术演变的推动作用，本篇调研将着重分析以下几个方面：一是爵士钢琴从经典爵士到现代爵士的风格演变；二是当代跨流派合作对爵士钢琴的艺术影响；三是技术创新（如音效处理、电子音乐的结合等）和即兴创作手法的革新对爵士钢琴艺术发展的推动。 此项调研将结合数以百计的现代演出视频、音乐创作数据以及关键演奏家访谈，构建一个多层次的分析框架，帮助阐明爵士钢琴在全球音乐创作背景下的持续创新与风格演变，更为理论和创作实践提供深入的分析视角。

# Overview

Across the global market, 20–30-year-old women are the fastest-growing segment in orthodontics and cosmetic surgery, motivated primarily by aesthetics and social confidence. Clear aligners and combined surgical-orthognathic procedures are increasingly popular in this cohort, with strong patient-reported satisfaction for facial appearance and self-esteem outcomes<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="22"></cite><cite id="16"></cite>.

# Common Aesthetic Priorities: Orthodontics vs. Cosmetic Surgery

Young adults aged 18–30 consistently rank the color and arrangement of their teeth as the most important aspects of dental appearance, with a majority expressing a desire to change their teeth’s appearance. Over 90% consider healthy, well-arranged teeth important to their appearance, yet only about a third are satisfied with their dental aesthetics<cite id="11"></cite>. In cosmetic surgery, large-scale surveys show that facial appearance is the most common motivation for procedures such as rhinoplasty and facelifts among women aged 20–39, with aesthetics driving about 80% of motivations in rhinoplasty and 70–80% in facelifts<cite id="25"></cite><cite id="24"></cite>.

# Orthodontics: Who Wants Treatment and Why

Among university students aged 18–30, three-quarters (75%) report wanting to change their teeth’s appearance, with 56.5% prioritizing color and 31.2% prioritizing arrangement<cite id="11"></cite>. Public perception surveys of Invisalign show that among respondents familiar with clear aligners, 60.1% are female and 42.6% are aged 18–24, indicating strong interest in minimally visible orthodontic options among young women<cite id="16"></cite>. Clear aligners have also been combined with orthognathic surgery to achieve rapid aesthetic results, with patients reporting satisfaction after short treatment timelines<cite id="7"></cite>.

# Cosmetic Surgery: Motivations and Satisfaction in 20–30-Year-Old Women

Psychological studies of surgical orthodontics show that women often focus on aesthetic improvement, while men also report mastication concerns; women also report more temporomandibular joint issues as motivations<cite id="6"></cite>. In combined orthognathic and rhinoplasty cases, patient satisfaction is high, with most reporting satisfaction and an increase in self-confidence, and both functional and aesthetic motivations being successfully met<cite id="22"></cite>. Retrospective analyses of simultaneous rhinoplasty with orthognathic surgery show high patient satisfaction and stable outcomes, with recommendations for stable maxillary support for the nose and careful intubation management during surgery<cite id="23"></cite><cite id="26"></cite>. For midface augmentation, combined approaches can address both functional and aesthetic concerns with high patient satisfaction and minimal complications<cite id="34"></cite>.

# Combined Orthodontic–Surgical Procedures: Evidence and Trends

There is growing evidence that combining orthognathic surgery with rhinoplasty, genioplasty, and midface augmentation can produce dramatic facial changes while maintaining harmony, with high patient satisfaction and minimal major complications<cite id="1"></cite><cite id="22"></cite><cite id="34"></cite>. Digital planning and surgery-first approaches with clear aligners have been used to accelerate aesthetic outcomes in skeletal Class III gummy smiles, with short treatment durations and stable results<cite id="7"></cite>. Fat grafting is increasingly used in conjunction with orthognathic surgery to improve aesthetic outcomes and postoperative healing, with high patient satisfaction and no donor site complications in reported cohorts<cite id="31"></cite><cite id="47"></cite>.

# Market Growth and Patient Segments

The global clear aligners market is expanding rapidly, with the market valued at $6.8 billion in 2025 and projected to reach $14.2 billion by 2034, reflecting strong consumer demand for aesthetically superior, minimally invasive orthodontic solutions<cite id="17"></cite>. In China, 20–30-year-old women make up the largest consumer segment for Invisalign, with 68% of cases in this age group and a strong presence among working professionals<cite id="18"></cite>. These trends suggest that young women are the primary demographic driving integration between orthodontics and cosmetic surgery<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="18"></cite>.

# Future Integration: Opportunities and Considerations

The psychological and aesthetic motivations of 20–30-year-old women align well with integrated treatment planning that combines orthodontic and surgical interventions. Evidence supports combining orthognathic surgery with rhinoplasty, genioplasty, and midface augmentation, as well as using clear aligners to accelerate aesthetic outcomes in complex cases<cite id="22"></cite><cite id="34"></cite><cite id="7"></cite>. Emerging techniques such as digital surgery-first planning, simultaneous nasal dorsum reduction, and fat grafting can enhance facial harmony and recovery while meeting patient expectations<cite id="27"></cite><cite id="31"></cite>. As clear aligners and minimally invasive surgical techniques become more accessible, bundling orthodontic and cosmetic treatments around the 20–30-year-old female patient appears both feasible and desirable<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="18"></cite><cite id="22"></cite>.

# Limitations

Direct, global survey data specifically quantifying the “common demand ratio” for combined orthodontic and aesthetic treatments among 20–30-year-old women was not identified in the available sources. The cited evidence provides strong regional and demographic trends, but a single worldwide percentage would require a dedicated, cross-region survey<cite id="11"></cite><cite id="16"></cite><cite id="22"></cite><cite id="25"></cite><cite id="17"></cite><cite id="18"></cite>.

Methods: During a 12-year period (January 1993 to April 2005), more than 500 patients with dentofacial deformities and malocclusions have undergone orthognathic surgery performed by a team consisting of the same plastic surgeons and orthodontists. Among this group, 53 patients (30 women and 23 men) underwent surgery for both aesthetic and functional concerns. The mean patient age was 20.4 years (range, 17-28 years). All the patients were treated with bimaxillary osteotomy, concomitant maxillomalar augmentation, osseous genioplasty, and rhinoplastic procedures in the same session. The patients were followed 12 to 44 months by the plastic surgeon, and at least 1 year by the orthodontist. Results: There was no orthognathic relapse or other major complications requiring reoperation. There was prolonged nerve anesthesia or hypoesthesia that resolved within 6 months for 4 patients (7.5%), a short period of anesthesia or hypoesthesia that resolved within 4 weeks for 11 patients (20.7%), a wide alar base in 3 patients, and a slight deviation of the cartilage septum in 2 patients. Conclusion: In one session, five different procedures can be performed without any problem, each of which can produce major changes to the face while maintaining the whole facial harmony. The authors describe a series of consecutive patients who underwent orthognathic surgery with fat grafting by the senior author and review relevant literature in the field; fat grafting technique is discussed in detail. The authors also highlight 3 patients to illustrate postoperative outcomes. Methods: A retrospective cohort of consecutive orthognathic surgery patients was reviewed. Results: Fifty-three orthognathic surgery patients with concurrent fat grafting were reviewed. The cohort comprised 20 males (37.7%) and 33 females (62.3%). <answer>
# How the World’s Wealthiest Governments Invest: A Data-Driven Overview

## What counts as a sovereign wealth fund?
A sovereign wealth fund (SWF) is a government-owned investment vehicle that manages national savings and typically invests in public and private equities, fixed income, real assets, and alternatives. Most SWFs are funded by commodity revenues or foreign exchange reserves and aim to preserve and grow wealth for future generations<cite id="73"></cite>. The Sovereign Wealth Fund Institute (SWFI) analyzes SWFs and related public institutional investors, providing data and rankings that underpin much of the public understanding of these funds<cite id="66"></cite>.

## Who are the world’s largest SWFs?
As of 2025, the world’s largest SWFs collectively manage about $13.7 trillion, with the top ten holding more than 70% of assets. Norway’s Government Pension Fund Global (GPFG) is the largest, with assets exceeding $1.74 trillion; it is also the largest single institutional shareholder, holding stakes in over 8,000 companies<cite id="21"></cite><cite id="2"></cite>. In 2025, GPFG’s assets totaled roughly $19.59 trillion in Norwegian kroner (equivalent to about $13.77 trillion), reflecting its dual mandate as a pension fund and long-term investor<cite id="2"></cite>. Other leading SWFs include China Investment Corporation (CIC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), together about $2.422 trillion; Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) with roughly $1.06 trillion; and Singapore’s Government Investment Corporation (GIC) and Temasek, which together hold about $1.315 trillion<cite id="59"></cite>. Broader rankings show the top 100 SWFs span a wide range of asset sizes and geographies, with oil-rich and surplus-exporting nations dominating the largest funds<cite id="56"></cite><cite id="60"></cite>.

## Investment strategies by major SWFs
Norway’s GPFG pursues a predominantly public-equity strategy, with a long-term, diversified portfolio that targets balanced risk premia. It maintains a policy portfolio split across equities, fixed income, and real assets, reflecting its mandate to deliver strong returns within a defined risk tolerance<cite id="17"></cite>. In 2025, GPFG held stakes in more than 8,000 listed companies worldwide, reinforcing its role as a major shareholder across markets<cite id="2"></cite>.

Singapore’s GIC emphasizes long-term real returns through a diversified global portfolio across equities, bonds, real estate, private equity, infrastructure, and alternatives. It organizes its activities through three independent entities—GIC Asset Management, GIC Real Estate, and GIC Private Equity—under the oversight of a Chief Investment Officer<cite id="16"></cite>. GIC’s policy portfolio targets a balanced mix of public and private assets, with active management focused on risk-adjusted returns and resilience<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="44"></cite>. In recent years, GIC has reduced bond and cash allocations while maintaining exposure to developed and emerging market equities and real estate, with a continued emphasis on prudent liquidity management<cite id="19"></cite>.

The United Arab Emirates’ Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) follows a globally diversified approach with targeted allocations to equities, fixed income, and alternatives. Its long-term strategy sets minimum and maximum ranges for each asset class, with a strong tilt toward public equities and a growing emphasis on alternatives and private markets<cite id="31"></cite><cite id="32"></cite>. ADIA has increased its private equity allocation to 12%–17% of total assets and reduced external management, reflecting a strategic shift toward internal expertise and direct private-market participation<cite id="34"></cite><cite id="32"></cite>. Geographically, ADIA targets 45%–60% in North America, 15%–30% in Europe, and 10%–20% in emerging markets, with a highly diversified portfolio across regions<cite id="35"></cite>.

China’s CIC and SAFE together form the country’s primary sovereign wealth framework, combining global diversification with a focus on long-term growth and resilience. CIC’s total portfolio framework integrates reference, policy, and actual portfolios to balance return objectives with risk constraints, while SAFE emphasizes conservative, globally diversified allocations to preserve and grow foreign exchange reserves<cite id="26"></cite><cite id="30"></cite><cite id="27"></cite>. In 2022, CIC reported that alternative assets comprised about 50% of its portfolio, with active engagement in climate and energy transition themes as part of its rebalancing and strategy refinement<cite id="28"></cite>.

Qatar’s Investment Authority (QIA) pursues a long-term, diversified strategy across public and private assets, with a formal top-down process that sets a Reference Portfolio and aligns annual plans with return objectives and risk tolerance. The fund maintains significant exposure to North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, and has increased asset-class diversification over time<cite id="49"></cite><cite id="48"></cite>. QIA’s portfolio includes notable strategic stakes in listed companies across financial services, luxury goods, technology, and industrial sectors, underscoring its active equity investor profile<cite id="46"></cite>.

Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) has evolved into a dual mandate: a global institutional investor and a national development engine. As of 2024, about 83% of assets were allocated domestically, with 17% internationally, reflecting a focus on both wealth preservation and domestic economic transformation<cite id="37"></cite>. PIF’s Vision Portfolio aims to unlock synergies across strategic sectors and integrate with the domestic private sector, while its broader strategy targets long-term growth and sustainable development<cite id="38"></cite>. Notably, PIF’s alternative allocations are higher than GPFG’s, with private equity, real estate, and infrastructure comprising about 55% of the portfolio<cite id="39"></cite>.

## Asset allocation patterns across the largest SWFs
The top SWFs exhibit broad diversification across geographies and asset classes. In 2025, the top 10 SWFs collectively held about $13.7 trillion, with Asia and the Middle East accounting for the majority of assets, underscoring the regional concentration of the largest sovereign wealth pools<cite id="58"></cite>. GPFG’s policy portfolio illustrates a typical mix of equities, fixed income, and real assets, while ADIA’s strategy emphasizes targeted ranges for each class and a growing alternative tilt<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="31"></cite>. CIC’s 2022 report showed alternative assets approaching 50% of its portfolio, highlighting the increasing role of private markets among major SWFs<cite id="28"></cite>.

## Performance and governance
GPFG’s performance in 2025 reflected its long-term, diversified approach, with assets exceeding $19.59 trillion in Norwegian kroner and a track record as one of the world’s largest and most active institutional shareholders<cite id="2"></cite>. GIC’s 2024 reporting highlighted a continued focus on long-term value, price discipline, and diversification, with AI adoption enhancing operational capacity and decision-making<cite id="18"></cite>. ADIA’s 2024 review detailed its operational and governance structures, including a board and investment committee that oversee long-term strategy and portfolio execution<cite id="32"></cite>. QIA’s governance framework ties asset allocation and risk management to a Reference Portfolio, ensuring strategic alignment over multi-year horizons<cite id="49"></cite>.

## Limitations and context
Publicly available data often aggregates multiple entities under national labels, so figures for China (CIC and SAFE) and Singapore (GIC and Temasek) reflect combined totals. Additionally, SWF strategies evolve rapidly, particularly as newer funds adopt more active and domestic-focused mandates alongside global diversification<cite id="59"></cite><cite id="37"></cite><cite id="39"></cite>. The SWFI provides authoritative rankings and data, but detailed holdings and real-time performance figures can be sensitive and subject to periodic disclosure cycles<cite id="66"></cite><cite id="56"></cite>.

## Summary
The world’s wealthiest governments increasingly deploy sovereign wealth vehicles to pursue long-term, diversified returns across public equities, fixed income, real assets, and alternatives. Norway’s GPFG exemplifies a large, globally diversified pension fund with a heavy equity tilt, while Singapore’s GIC emphasizes balanced, long-term allocation across independent investment arms<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="16"></cite>. ADIA and CIC showcase growing private-market exposure and active engagement with climate and transition themes, and Saudi PIF demonstrates a hybrid model that blends global investing with domestic development priorities<cite id="31"></cite><cite id="28"></cite><cite id="38"></cite><cite id="37"></cite>. Together, these case studies illustrate a spectrum of strategies, with common themes of diversification, risk management, and a commitment to sustainable long-term growth<cite id="44"></cite><cite id="49"></cite><cite id="17"></cite>.
</answer>

problem:
(working on LN-based nonlinear photonics):
Possible ways to mitigate the material damage of LN after plasma etching?
final_response:
<think>>
<answer>
# Mitigating plasma-etched lithium niobate damage in LN-based nonlinear photonics

## Executive summary
Plasma etching is a cornerstone of lithium niobate (LN) nanofabrication but can leave residual redeposited material and surface damage that degrade optical quality and electro-optic stability. The most robust mitigation strategies include optimizing etch parameters to reach a redeposition-free regime, using redeposition-resistant hard masks, and applying brief, controlled sputter etching or mild thermal annealing to remove the plasma-affected surface layer. In many cases, redeposition-free argon inductively coupled plasma (ICP) etching yields smooth sidewalls and sub-1 dB/cm waveguide losses without wet chemistry, while sputter etching a few tens of nanometers can suppress electro-optic drift in bulk LN. For long-term stability, passivation with native oxide or a thin lithium oxysulfide layer can be preferable to avoid metallic contamination and electrochemical instability<cite id="31"></cite><cite id="11"></cite><cite id="37"></cite><cite id="53"></cite><cite id="14"></cite>.

## Why plasma etching causes damage and performance degradation
Reactive-ion plasma etching of LN commonly produces micro-masking and redeposition, especially with fluorocarbon chemistries, and can leave LiF residues that weaken adhesion of overlayers and induce waveguide chipping. Even with argon physical etching, redeposition and near-unit mask selectivity complicate deep-etch profiles, necessitating post-etch cleaning steps to remove redeposited LN from sidewalls<cite id="6"></cite><cite id="11"></cite>. Beyond morphology, plasma exposure can introduce interfacial conduction pathways that increase RF/optical losses, particularly during deep etching; adding a trap-rich poly-silicon layer at the LNOI interface suppresses these losses, underscoring plasma’s impact on device-level performance<cite id="21"></cite>.

## 1. Optimize etch parameters to minimize redeposition
Process-agnostic workflows identify parameter sets that suppress micro-masking and achieve redeposition-free etching with good sidewall quality across different plasma systems. Three redeposition-free methods include: (i) etching at low ion energy with high ion flux, (ii) increasing the ICP/ECR coupling coefficient to raise ion energy, and (iii) operating at high ion energy with low ion flux; all can produce smooth, redeposition-free LN waveguide sidewalls without wet chemistry<cite id="31"></cite>. In practice, argon ICP etching can yield single-mode ridge waveguides with losses around 5 dB/cm once redeposition is controlled, demonstrating the importance of parameter choice for optical quality<cite id="53"></cite>.

## 2. Use redeposition-resistant hard masks
Hard-mask selection strongly influences redeposition behavior and etch profile. Indirectly coupled plasma etching with a sacrificial SiO₂ mask can reduce redeposition compared to a Si₃N₄ mask, enabling high-aspect-ratio, single-mode waveguides with propagation and coupling losses around 10 dB and 2 dB, respectively<cite id="11"></cite>. More broadly, SiO₂ is preferred over Si₃N₄ for deep reactive etching of LN because it exhibits lower redeposition and better etch profile control<cite id="14"></cite>.

## 3. Post-etch cleaning to remove redeposits
Even with optimized argon etching, redeposited LN can accumulate on sidewalls, increasing propagation loss and degrading mode matching. A final wet etch step effectively removes these redeposits, yielding single-mode waveguides with total (propagation and coupling) losses near 10 dB and improved optical quality<cite id="53"></cite>. Systematic studies also recommend chemical cleaning to remove redeposited material from etched photonic structures before device testing<cite id="11"></cite>.

## 4. Controlled sputter etch to remove the plasma-affected surface layer
Brief sputter etching removes the top surface layer introduced during plasma etching, suppressing electro-optic drift. In bulk LN, sputter-etching more than 20 nm of the substrate surface reduces dc drift and enables drift-induced crosstalk below −25 dB at 1.3 μm<cite id="37"></cite>. For LN-on-insulator (LNOI), sputter etching 20 nm of the oxide layer before electrode deposition suppresses electro-optic drift by more than an order of magnitude, with no measurable change in waveguide loss, indicating minimal impact on optical quality<cite id="58"></cite>. Thermal annealing at 350 °C for 1 hour after ICP etching similarly suppresses drift by more than an order of magnitude without increasing waveguide loss, reinforcing that removing the plasma-affected layer is the key mechanism<cite id="59"></cite>.

## 5. Surface passivation to stabilize device performance
Passivation with native oxide or a thin lithium oxysulfide (Li₂O·xSiO₂) layer can mitigate electrochemical instability and drift by passivating defects and interfaces. In LNOI, a 20 nm native oxide layer suppresses electro-optic drift by more than an order of magnitude, while a 5 nm Li₂O·xSiO₂ layer reduces drift by ~20% and lowers propagation loss by ~0.1 dB/cm, improving both stability and optical performance<cite id="14"></cite>. These results suggest that passivation is most effective when combined with removal of the plasma-affected surface layer, as sputter etching or thermal annealing provides<cite id="14"></cite><cite id="58"></cite><cite id="59"></cite>.

## 6. Avoid fluorocarbon chemistries for waveguides with overlying layers
Fluorocarbon plasmas can deposit LiF on etched LN surfaces, weakening adhesion of overlying films such as SiO₂ and causing waveguide chipping; CHF₃ can mitigate notches at waveguide feet compared to CF₄, but redeposition and micro-masking remain challenges that require careful process optimization<cite id="6"></cite>. For waveguides where overlayer adhesion is critical, argon physical etching with redeposition control is generally preferable<cite id="11"></cite><cite="53"></cite>.

## Practical recommendations
- Choose argon ICP etching and tune parameters (low ion energy/high flux, high coupling coefficient, or high ion energy/low flux) to reach a redeposition-free regime, avoiding fluorocarbon chemistries for waveguides with overlying layers<cite id="31"></cite><cite id="53"></cite><cite id="6"></cite>.
- Use SiO₂ as the hard mask to minimize redeposition and improve deep-etch profiles<cite id="14"></cite>.
- Perform a final wet etch to remove redeposited LN from sidewalls, yielding single-mode waveguides with improved optical quality<cite id="53"></cite>.
- Immediately after etching, apply a brief sputter etch (>20 nm) or thermal anneal (~350 °C, 1 hour) to remove the plasma-affected surface layer; both suppress electro-optic drift without measurable optical loss<cite id="37"></cite><cite id="58"></cite><cite id="59"></cite>.
- Deposit a thin native oxide or lithium oxysulfide passivation layer to further stabilize device performance and reduce loss<cite id="14"></cite>.

## Uncertainties and limitations
Direct, quantitative studies of how sputter etching or annealing affects electro-optic coefficients in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) are limited in the literature surveyed; most evidence comes from bulk LN or LNOI devices where drift suppression is well documented but EO coefficient changes are not explicitly measured<cite id="37"></cite><cite id="58"></cite><cite id="59"></cite>. Additional characterization is needed to assess passivation-induced changes in nonlinear coefficients for LN-based nonlinear photonics<cite id="14"></cite>.

## Conclusion
Plasma-etched LN damage can be mitigated through process optimization, redeposition-resistant masks, post-etch cleaning, and controlled removal of the plasma-affected surface layer via sputter etching or thermal annealing. These steps, combined with surface passivation, consistently suppress electro-optic drift and improve optical quality across LN platforms, enabling reliable electro-optic and acousto-optic devices for nonlinear integrated photonics<cite id="31"></cite><cite id="11"></cite><cite id="37"></cite><cite id="53"></cite><cite id="58"></cite><cite id="59"></cite><cite id="14"></cite>.

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="mitigate material damage of lithium niobate after plasma etching passivation" search_time="2026年5月16日12时54分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:6"><title>Hybrid integration of silicon photonic devices on lithium niobate for optomechanical wavelength conversion</title><summary>Hybrid photonic devices have attracted significant attention for their potential in both classical and quantum information processing [1–4]. While both classical materials rarely possess all desired properties, the combination of several materials allows for superior designs needed for the realization of photonic circuits that include light generation, guiding, modulation, and detection. For example, the integration of silicon photonic circuits with classical photon sources [5, 7] or two dimensional materials [6], and single light sources [8] has been demonstrated, promising new capabilities beyond what is achievable with a homogeneous approach. This optimization and combination of several desired properties often comes at the expense of significantly more complex fabrication procedures, complicating the development of more advanced hybrid photonic devices. Different material systems typically react differently to chemicals or etching procedures, leading to incompatibilities in the fabrication process. Here we present a novel approach to the fabrication of hybrid devices, based on the “pick-and-place” procedure, which is agnostic to the photonic material and compatible across a large range of different platforms. Although cells are exposed to mechanical and thermal stress, acoustic tweezers are usually considered as biocompatible. Here, we present a holistic experimental approach to reveal the correlation between acoustic fields, acoustophoretic motion and heating effects of particles induced by an acoustic tweezer setup. The system is based on surface acoustic waves and was characterized by applying laser Doppler vibrometry, astigmatism particle tracking velocimetry and luminescence lifetime imaging. problem: 中国金融未来的发展趋势，未来哪一个细分领域（例如投行、pe、固收等）更有上升空间
final_response:

<answer>
## 中国金融未来的发展趋势

中国金融体系正经历从规模扩张向高质量发展的深刻转型，核心特征是“财富管理时代全面开启”与“综合化经营加速”。居民可投资资产规模突破160万亿元，叠加资管新规净值化全面完成，预计2026年全市场资产管理规模将突破200万亿元，其中理财公司占据绝对主导地位，市占率约88.4%，头部机构加速“全牌照”协同构建财富生态<cite id="32"></cite><cite id="45"></cite><cite id="41"></cite>。与此同时，商业银行综合化转型持续推进，“商行+投行”模式通过投资联动、大资本市场及传统投行业务三种形式拓展盈利来源，长期将提升国际竞争力<cite id="3"></cite>。

## 分行业比较：投行、PE/VC、固收/资管的前景分析

### 投行业务：复苏与分化并存，头部效应强化
2025年券商投行业务迎来明显复苏，手续费净收入同比大增35%-38%，头部机构凭借资源与生态优势持续领跑，前五家券商投行收入合计占比达48.92%，竞争逻辑从承销规模转向全生命周期产业赋能与跨境服务能力<cite id="11"></cite><cite id="12"></cite><cite id="15"></cite>。股权融资端IPO节奏受政策影响波动，但再融资成为主要推动力，预计2026年港股IPO、并购重组、产业债及创业板改革将带来增量业务机会，中小券商需聚焦区域与细分赛道差异化突破<cite id="15"></cite><cite id="14"></cite>。

### PE/VC：募资与投资双升，早期资本仍处低位
2025年中国VC/PE市场新设基金6,127支，募资30.86万亿元，同比分别增长27%和26%，显示资本对创新领域的持续加码；但早期投资募资仅287亿元，占比极低，PE主导格局短期内难改<cite id="17"></cite><cite id="19"></cite>。2026年亚太PE年鉴指出，2025年中国PE市场募资3.1万亿元，投资2.0万亿元，退出渠道多元化，机构需提升投后管理与退出能力以应对市场周期<cite id="18"></cite>。综合判断，PE赛道具备长期增长潜力，但早期VC面临募资与退出双重约束，需精选赛道与项目。

### 固收与资管业务：低利率下的“固收+”与主动管理崛起
在利率中枢下行背景下，券商资管与公募固收+策略加速转向多资产配置与主动管理，头部机构标品投资占比超50%，产品规模稳步增长，2026年一季度资管收入同比+33%，行业进入“质量竞争期”<cite id="21"></cite><cite id="23"></cite><cite id="31"></cite>。银行理财子公司与理财公司亦在“全牌照+大协同”中巩固地位，2025年末银行理财存续33.29万亿元，头部理财公司管理规模逼近2万亿元，ESG与养老等主题产品布局提速<cite id="44"></cite><cite id="42"></cite><cite id="41"></cite>。信托行业“三分类”改革后，主动管理与资产服务信托替代通道业务，2025年末信托资产规模达34.1万亿元，标品占比提升，家族信托与财富服务需求增长<cite id="50"></cite><cite id="46"></cite>。

## 哪个细分领域更具上升空间？——基于趋势与能力的判断
- **短期（1-2年）**：投行复苏与头部集中、PE募资与投资双升、固收+与资管规模扩张并行，三者均具备结构性机会。但若以“成长性”与“竞争壁垒”排序，PE/VC赛道更具上升空间，因其受益于科技创新与资本深化的长期周期，且募资端韧性较强；而投行与资管则呈现“强者恒强”的分化态势，中小机构需借力生态或聚焦细分领域<cite id="11"></cite><cite id="17"></cite><cite id="21"></cite>。
- **中长期（3-5年）**：财富管理与养老金融将成为核心增长极，银行理财子公司、券商资管及信托主动管理能力的协同提升，将重塑“大资管”生态，相关机构有望持续受益<cite id="41"></cite><cite id="45"></cite><cite id="46"></cite>。

## 风险提示与建议
- 政策与监管：资管新规过渡完成后的净值化运营、ESG与养老金融配套规则、信托“三分类”转型的持续深化，将重塑盈利模式与竞争格局<cite id="32"></cite><cite id="46"></cite>。
- 市场周期：利率波动、信用风险定价与退出效率可能影响固收与PE赛道收益，需强化大类配置与投后赋能能力<cite id="23"></cite><cite id="18"></cite>。
- 战略选择：建议关注具备“全牌照协同”与主动管理能力的机构，或深耕区域/细分赛道的差异化投行与PE团队，同时布局ESG、养老与资产服务信托等政策导向领域<cite id="41"></cite><cite id="50"></cite><cite id="46"></cite>。

综上，中国金融未来将由财富管理驱动、综合化与主动管理能力决定胜负，PE/VC在科技创新周期中具备更强的上升空间，而投行与资管则在分化中为头部机构持续创造价值<cite id="11"></cite><cite id="17"></cite><cite id="15"></cite><cite id="21"></cite><cite id="45"></cite>.
</answer>

/></author_list><url>http://lib.cqvip.com/Qikan/Article/Detail?id=22616081</url><publish_time>2006年8月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:3"><title>银行业 “商行 + 投行” 模式的现状、经验与建议</title><summary>“商行 + 投行” 又称商投联动，其本质是商业银行突破传统存贷汇业务，进行综合化转型的过程，也是经济转型升级到一定阶段后银行业发展的必由之路。国际经验表明，“商行 + 投行” 的综合性经营模式能够在一定程度上拓展银行盈利来源、扩大市场份额，并可提升本国银行业的国际竞争力。近年来，在产业结构升级、“金融脱媒”、客户融资需求多样化的背景下，我国多家商业银行相继提出向 “商行 + 投行” 转型的策略。整体来看，短期内我国银行 “商行 + 投行” 开展形式可主要分为投资联动、大资本市场和传统投行业务三类，对我国银行利润的直接影响相对有限，更多体现为间接影响。但从长期看，广义的商投联动正在我国逐步发展，“以顾促融” 全面获取商业银行投行服务收益、实现综合化经营的时代正在到来。</summary><hostname>中国国际金融学会</hostname><publisher>国际金融</publisher><author_list><author name="王剑" affiliation="国信证券经济研究所" /><author name="贺晨" affiliation="粤开证券经济研究所" /><author name="陈俊良" affiliation="国信证券经济研究所" /></author_list><url>https://chinaifs.org.cn/upload/1/editor/1723442197645.pdf</url><publish_time>2021年7月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:4"><title>现代商业银行核心竞争力的结构性解释</title><summary>本文在若干假设基础上,用“圈状”理论方法对现代商业银行核心竞争力进行结构性解释:第一圈为人才和组织结构竞争力,突出领军者和战略管理的核心作用;第二圈为资本、风险和技术结构竞争力,揭示经营资源开发利用的核心价值;第三圈为业务结构竞争力,阐述提高市场竞争力的核心策略。“三圈六元素”是个互相依存并进行信息交流的统一整体,按一定次序排列、组合,并互相影响和转换,形成一种独特的、不易模仿的能级和张力,转化为市场竞争优势和可持续发展能力。第一、二圈的所有结构竞争力元素围绕业务结构竞争力,提供决策、人才、信息、技术等多方面支撑。</summary><hostname>库问搜索</hostname><publisher>金融论坛2007年第1期</publisher><author_list><author name="朱纯福" /></author_list><url>http://www.koovin.com/?a=downloadpdf&id=17727396&file_name=68CEA8A2F62C855E62080E8CB8501E7A&doaction=download</url><publish_time>2007年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:5"><title>中国证券行业的回顾及思考</title><summary>伴随着中国经济改革开放和资本市场的快速发展，中国证券行业历经28年的波折和锤炼，从无到有、从小到大、从本土化到国际化、从粗放经营到规范发展，取得了巨大成就。行业规模迅速扩大，资本实力显著提升，业务体系日益完善，治理水平和风控能力大幅提高，科技化程度不断加深，多层次资本市场有序搭建，为实体经济发展提供了强有力的支持。我作为证券行业的一名老兵，在证券行业一线耕耘近30年，亲身经历和见证了证券行业的巨大变迁，抚今追昔，感触良多。在此结合自己的工作经历，对中国证券行业做些回顾与思考，仅供参考。中国证券业是在改革开放大背景下形成与发展起来的，没有起始于40年前的改革开放，没有当时自上而下的思想大解放，就没有中国的证券市场和证券行业。邓小平于1986年11月在人民大会堂会见华尔街金融巨头，标志着改革开放的中国正式拥抱现代金融，证券、股票这些曾被妖魔化的“怪物”，开始进入我们的经济生活。经过近30年的发展，中国已成为世界第二大资本市场，多层次资本市场体系架构基本完成搭建。截至2017年底，沪深两市上市公司达3 485家，总市值56.71万亿元，新三板市场共有挂牌公司11 630家，总股本6 756.73亿股。与此同时，证券行业经过这些年的转型创新和综合治理，其规模、实力和能力都达到了新的高度，已成长为国民经济和金融市场体系中的重要组成部分。截至2017年底，国内共有证券公司131家，业务体系相对完备，涵盖经纪业务、证券承销和发行业务、财务顾问业务、资产管理业务、融资类业务、国际化业务及衍生品业务等。回顾中国资本市场和证券行业的发展历

## Executive summary

China’s financial system has become large, diversified, and highly interconnected, with growing financial interlinkages posing systemic risk concerns. Authorities have called for strengthening internal coordination, improving information sharing among regulators, and enhancing comprehensive analysis of systemic risk to address these challenges<cite id="7"></cite>. The architecture of financial networks can both mitigate and amplify risk depending on shock size and connectivity, highlighting the need for careful modeling of interdependencies<cite id="1"></cite>. Empirical evidence shows that China’s financial network exhibits “small world” and “scale-free” characteristics with significant time-varying connectedness, and total connectedness peaks during stress periods, underscoring the importance of dynamic, multi-layer models for risk assessment<cite id="8"></cite><cite id="36"></cite>.

## Overview of financial interlinkages and systemic risk in China

China’s shadow banking system has grown rapidly, engaging in regulatory arbitrage and financial innovation, and is closely tied to banks. Its increasing scale and evolving structure pose new regulatory challenges and highlight the need for in-depth monitoring and policy design<cite id="41"></cite><cite id="43"></cite>. The IMF has emphasized that China’s changing financial landscape—with its rising interconnectedness—could produce systemic risk, urging stronger inter-agency coordination, better information sharing, and enhanced analysis of systemic risk<cite id="7"></cite>. These observations set the stage for a layered analysis of different types of investment and lending relationships and their associated risk transmission channels<cite id="7"></cite><cite id="41"></cite>.

## Interbank and balance-sheet contagion in the formal banking sector

Studies of China’s financial networks show that total connectedness among institutions rises sharply during stress, peaking in periods such as mid-2014 to end-2016. While large commercial banks and insurers often exhibit systemic importance, some smaller firms can also be systemically important due to high levels of incoming or outgoing connectedness<cite id="36"></cite>. This dynamic behavior supports the use of tail-event-driven network models to capture stress-induced risk spillovers and identify systemically important entities<cite id="36"></cite>. A multilayer network approach that integrates liability and equity cross-holdings further reveals how network structure relates to systemic risk, offering a more comprehensive view of contagion mechanisms in the formal sector<cite id="38"></cite>.

## Shadow banking: trust loans, asset management, and leverage cycles

Trust companies have played a central role in China’s shadow banking system, generating leverage cycle dynamics by intermediating less-regulated credit. Leverage factors derived from trust companies possess strong explanatory power for time-series and cross-sectional asset returns, indicating that shadow banking innovations amplify leverage in less sophisticated markets and affect financial fragility and asset prices<cite id="18"></cite>. A sector-level measurement framework focusing on unexpected losses from balance-sheet contagion shows that trust companies were the main source of instability, with commercial banks assuming the bulk of risk during 2007–12<cite id="37"></cite>. Micro-level evidence using transaction data constructs virtual balance sheets and integrates them with asset price contagion models, revealing that shadow banking can exhibit high and volatile systemic risk driven by policy shocks and business-scale changes<cite id="26"></cite>.

## Asset management products: complexity, interconnectedness, and regulatory impact

A shadow banking perspective on China’s systemic risk shows that asset management products can act as key transmission channels. Empirical work on China’s financial institutions constructs a systemic risk spillover network and finds that the network has “small world” and “scale-free” properties with significant time-varying connectedness; during extreme market conditions, inter-institutional connectedness increases dramatically<cite id="8"></cite>. Using R-Vine Copula and DCC-GARCH-CoVaR, studies of listed financial sub-sectors document high time-varying linkage before 2017, which declined under financial strict regulation, with banking showing the largest systemic risk spillover and securities accumulating the largest scale of systemic risk<cite id="28"></cite>. A complex-network analysis of China’s asset management market finds that the market is highly interconnected, with each sector acting as a risk receiver or driver; it also exhibits “small world” and “scale-free” properties and significant time-varying connectedness, reinforcing the need for dynamic risk monitoring<cite id="31"></cite>.

## Function-based regulation and the “asset management law” era

The People’s Bank of China’s “Guiding Opinions on Improving the Function of the Asset Management Industry” proposes a function-based regulatory framework that classifies products by investment objects and terms, and aligns returns with risks to reduce leverage and multi-layer nesting. This approach aims to mitigate the “debt-product” mispricing that contributed to excessive leverage and risk accumulation in the asset management sector<cite id="45"></cite>. Function-based regulation is consistent with broader calls to better supervise shadow financial institutions based on their functions to reduce regulatory arbitrage and systemic fragility<cite id="11"></cite>.

## Key drivers and determinants of interconnectedness and risk

Empirical evidence indicates that asset size, leverage, and the SRISK index positively influence the connection degree among financial institutions, while the current ratio and changes in the real estate climate index have opposite effects<cite id="8"></cite>. These findings highlight the importance of prudential indicators in shaping network topology and systemic risk exposure, and suggest that macroprudential policies should target leverage and liquidity profiles across institutions<cite id="8"></cite>.

## Modeling approaches across layers and channels

A growing literature proposes multilayer network models that integrate liability and equity cross-holdings to capture the dynamic mechanism of financial contagion, providing a new systemic risk measurement that reflects interactions across formal and shadow sectors<cite id="38"></cite>. Tail-event-driven networks at specific risk levels (e.g., 1%) enable dynamic assessment of total connectedness and the identification of systemically important institutions during stress<cite id="36"></cite>. Balance-sheet contagion models that trace unexpected losses and use loop algorithms for risk transfer are particularly suited to shadow banking, where trust companies dominate instability transmission<cite id="37"></cite>. Virtual balance-sheet constructions from transaction-level data combined with asset price contagion models offer a micro-founded approach to measuring shadow banking systemic risk and its sensitivity to policy shocks<cite id="26"></cite>.

## Policy implications and recommendations

Regulators should strengthen internal coordination, institutionalize information sharing, and enhance comprehensive analysis of systemic risk to address rising interlinkages<cite id="7"></cite>. Dynamic, multilayer network models that incorporate both liabilities and equity cross-holdings can better assess stress-induced connectedness and systemic importance across the financial system<cite id="38"></cite><cite id="36"></cite>. Monitoring leverage and liquidity profiles is essential, given their significant influence on interconnectedness and risk spillovers<cite id="8"></cite>. Function-based regulation of asset management products—aligning returns with risks, reducing leverage and nesting, and improving transparency—can mitigate mispricing and excessive leverage that amplify systemic fragility<cite id="45"></cite><cite id="18"></cite>. Continued surveillance of trust-driven shadow banking and efforts to break the illusion of “implicit guarantees” are needed to curb risk accumulation and prevent fragility from spilling over into the formal sector<cite id="26"></cite><cite id="11"></cite>.

## Limitations and future research directions

This synthesis relies on available academic and policy sources; some data, particularly at the micro-transaction level, may be limited or subject to evolving disclosure practices. Future work should expand granular transaction data across asset managers, trusts, and specialized banks to refine virtual balance-sheet models and stress-testing frameworks, and integrate macro-financial scenarios to evaluate policy responses under different shock regimes<cite id="26"></cite><cite id="37"></cite><cite id="41"></cite>.

(JEL D85, E44, G21, G28, L14) Since the global financial crisis of 2008, the view that the architecture of the financial system plays a central role in shaping systemic risk has become conventional wisdom. The intertwined nature of the financial markets has not only been proffered as an explanation for the spread of risk throughout the system (see, e.g., Plosser 2009 and Yellen 2013), but also motivated many of the policy actions both during and in the aftermath of the crisis.¹ Such views have even been incorporated into the new regulatory frameworks developed since.² Yet, the exact role played by the financial system’s architecture in creating systemic risk remains, at best, imperfectly understood. Globalisation has been accompanied by rapid financial liberalisation and deregulation, leading to intense competition among big financial institutions, both domestic and foreign. Given this, the importance of shadow banking from the point of view of systemic stability of financial systems and its recessionary impact on the real economy cannot be overlooked. Shadow banking exists alongside the formal banking system, offering similar kinds of services, but it is lightly or not regulated at all. <search query="中国 金融控股公司 风险 跨行业 跨市场 系统性风险 监管" search_time="2026年5月16日12时57分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:21"><title>我国交叉性金融业务的风险监管与防控</title><summary>交叉性金融业务作为综合经营背景下的创新产物,在丰富产品种类、满足多样化投资需求等方面发挥了重要作用,但同时也增加了交叉性金融风险与系统性风险爆发的可能性。《党和国家机构改革方案》的落地实施进一步证明加快我国金融管理体制改革、防范化解重大风险的重要性。因此,深入剖析我国交叉性金融业务的运作模式及潜在风险具有重要的理论与现实意义。本文归纳了交叉性金融业务的发展历程与运作模式,从业务模式、业务主体、监管框架及法律规章等角度重点分析了当前我国交叉性金融业务监管的不足之处,并基于此提出风险监管与防控的政策建议。</summary><hostname>手机知网</hostname><publisher>西南金融</publisher><author_list><author name="卜林" affiliation="天津财经大学金融学院" /><author name="任硕" affiliation="天津财经大学金融学院" /></author_list><url>https://wap.cnki.net/touch/web/Journal/Article/SCJR202306004.html</url><publish_time>2023年6月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:22"><title>金融控股公司系统性风险防控与监管路径选择</title><summary>摘要：金融控股公司是随着金融市场的分业监管向混业监管过渡时期而出现的新型金融机构，新的金融机构模式带来了新的挑战，首当其冲的就是其风险由内部聚集进而外溢化最终导致的系统性风险，其中作为系统性风险理论基础的风险可联动传递性包括从公司治理结构层面的内部传递性以及从域外监管出发的外部联动性。对我国现在金融控股公司存在的风险内控和监管问题，既要从内部治理方面进行完善，还要从立法体系和监管机构进行外部把控。</summary><hostname>手机知网</hostname><publisher>金融法学家</publisher><author_list><author name="郑萌" affiliation="上海对外经贸大学法学院" /></author_list><url>https://wap.cnki.net/touch/web/Conference/Article/YHFX201811001005.html</url></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:23"><title>金融控股公司混业经营风险分析及对策探讨</title><summary>本文通过借鉴发达国家走混业经营之路的经验，立足国际金融发展环境，分析了我国金融业采用金融控股公司混业经营的优势和我国实行金融控股模式面临的风险，从宏观、中观、微观三个层面提出了改进我国金融控股公司混业经营的对策，为我国金融业行业发展提供借鉴。</summary><hostname>pdf2012.ckyk.cn</hostname><publisher>财会月刊</publisher><author_list><author name="叶敏娣" affiliation="咸宁学院 湖北咸宁 437100" /></author_list><url>http://pdf2012.ckyk.cn/upload_files/20110629/4888727.pdf</url><publish_time>2010年11月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:24"><title>我国现阶段跨市场金融风险的传递载体刍议</title><summary>我国正经历从分业经营向综合经营转变的重要时期，伴随产生的跨市场金融风险因其复杂性与危害性而亟待研究。本文对跨市场金融风险界定后，将现阶段我国跨市场金融风险的传递载体分为三类：交叉性金融产品、全国公开性金融市场、金融控股公司。剖析了跨市场金融风险在不同载体中的传递方式与风险特点，并基于前文分析建议构建我国的“伞式综合监管＋功能监管”模式，以有效防范跨市场金融风险。</summary><hostname>维普文库</hostname><publisher>上海金融</publisher><cite_count>3</cite_count><author_list><author name="丁浩" /><author name="许长新" /></author_list><url>http://lib.cqvip.com/Qikan/Article/Detail?id=26772183</url><publish_time>2008年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:25"><title>我国金融混业经营的监管问题研究</title><summary>随着金融竞争的加剧、金融需求的变化和信息技术的发展,混业经营已成为我国金融业发展的必然趋势。本文以我国金融混业经营的背景和现状为出发点,在分析我国金融混业经营监管困境的基础上,有针对性地提出我国金融混业经营的监管对策。abstract:along The thesis begins with the background and actuality of the Chinese financial mixed management, then proposes some pertinence monitor countermeasures on the base of analyzing the monitor puzzledoms in Chinese financial mixed management.</summary><hostname>维普文库</hostname><publisher>特区经济</publisher><author_list><author name="陈红" affiliation="中国矿业大学管理学院" /><author name="张运红" affiliation="中国矿业大学管理学院" /></author_list><url>http://lib.cqvip.com/Qikan/Article/Detail?id=29992954</url><publish_time>2009年3月1日0时0分</publish_time></document>

reference_id="<|superscript|>:26"><title>影子银行系统性风险度量研究——基于中国信托公司逐笔业务的数据视角</title><summary>本文基于微观业务数据,构建资产价格传染模型,提出了影子银行系统性风险度量的两步法:第一步,以微观业务数据为基础,构建虚拟机构资产负债表;第二步,将虚拟机构资产负债表与资产价格传染模型相结合,度量系统性风险.结果显示,样本期间影子银行系统性风险较高且波动剧烈.原因在于,样本区间的外部政策冲击变动导致微观业务规模及杠杆发生变动,进而驱动系统性风险的波动.为防范影子银行系统性风险,需要做好:第一,注重监测影子金融机构的业务层面风险;第二,打破影子机构的刚性兑付体制;第三,监管政策应有长期规划以及连续性.此外,与传统研究得出刚性兑付是隐藏风险、导致未来风险爆发不同的是,本文发现刚性兑付是引发风险的导火索.</summary><hostname>掌桥科研</hostname><publisher>国际金融研究</publisher><author_list><author name="方意" /><author name="韩业" /><author name="荆中博" /></author_list><url>https://www.zhangqiaokeyan.com/academic-journal-cn_detail_thesis/02012100604070.html</url><publish_time>2019年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:27"><title>基于影子银行视角的我国系统性金融风险测度及预警研究</title><summary>本文编制了我国影子银行部门的资产负债表,准确识别我国影子银行规模,分析影子银行基于资产负债表渠道的系统性金融风险传染机制。基于蒙特卡洛模拟构建了以影子银行为中心节点的金融机构间网络模型,得出三种不同集中度金融机构间网络的系统性金融风险损失的VaR和ES值,对我国影子银行违约引发的系统性金融风险进行测度。基于此,划分了“绿色可控区”、“橙色预警区”和“红色风险区”三类级别的系统性风险区间,构建了以影子银行资产规模/GDP为核心,同时考虑经济增速和货币环境的风险预警指标,并以美国次贷危机前后影子银行资产规模占GDP比重作为参照系,得出我国金融业系统性风险预警指标区间值,并据此提出加强对影子银行管理与隔离、做好影子银行风险识别与监测、将影子银行纳入广义宏观审慎管理体系、建立影子银行风险预警和处置机制的政策建议。</summary><hostname>维普</hostname><publisher>金融发展研究</publisher><author_list><author name="中国人民银行西安分行课题组" /><author name="白鹤祥(课题主持人)" /><author name="袁庆春" /><author name="钱皓" /><author name="刘社芳" /><author name="刘蕾蕾" /><author name="罗小伟" /><author name="李善燊" /></author_list><url>http://www.cqvip.com/QK/81137X/201811/7000950174.html</url><publish_time>2018年1月1日0时0分</publish_time></document><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:28"><title>关联网络、风险溢出与重要系统性金融机构识别——基于市场、行业和机构的实证</title><summary>以各金融子行业（保险、信托、银行、证券、其他非银行金融）的上市机构为研究对象，采用 R-Vine Copula 方法和 DCC-GARCH-CoVaR 方法来分析各机构之间的时变联动性、关联网络特征及其系统性风险溢出效应，进而识别出重要系统性金融机构。研究结论表明：在 2017 年以前，各金融子行业之间存在较高的时变联动性，但随后在金融严监管的影响下出现持续下降趋势。在金融机构相依结构方面，同行业的金融机构存在明显的集聚效应。所有金融机构之间均存在正相依性，大部分金融机构之间存在上下尾对称的相依结构特征。对金融市场存在最大系统性风险溢出效应的是银行业；相比其他金融子行业，证券业自身积累的系统性风险规模最大，而银行业最小。基于影响深度（系统性风险溢出效应）和影响广度（关联网络地位）的标准识别出中国银行、中国人寿、陕国投 A、中信证券和广发证券为我国重要系统性金融机构。相关研究结论将为构建多层次金融系统性风险防范体系提供有益借鉴。
Abstract: Taking the listed companies in various financial sub - industries (insurance, trust, banking, securities, and other non - banking finance) as research objects, the R - Vine Copula method and the DCC - GARCH - CoVaR method are used to analyze the time - varying linkage network characteristics between companies and its systemic risk spillover effect, and then identify systemic important financial institutions. The research conclusions show that before 2017, there was a high degree of time - varying linkage among various financial sub - sectors, but they continued to decline under the influence of strict financial supervision. In terms of financial institution dependent structures, there are obvious agglomeration effects in financial institutions in the same industry. Positive correlation exists among all financial institutions, and there are symmetric and dependent structural characteristics among most financial institutions. The largest systemic risk spillover effect on financial markets is banking; compared with other financial sub - sectors, the securities industry itself has accumulated the largest systemic risk, and the banking industry has the smallest. Based on the criteria of impact depth (systematic risk spillover effect) and the breadth of impact (association of network status), Bank of China, China Life Insurance, Shantou State Investment A, CITIC Securities, and GF Securities are identified as important institutional financial institutions in China. The relevant research conclusions will provide a useful reference for building a multi - level financial systemic risk prevention system.</summary><hostname>中央财经大学学报</hostname><publisher>中央财经大学学报2019年第5期</publisher><author_list><author name="郭文伟" affiliation="广东财经大学金融学院" /><author name="王礼昱" affiliation="广东财经大学金融学院" /></author_list><url>https://xbbjb.cufe.edu.cn/CN/abstract/abstract6352.shtml</url><publish_time>2019年9月17日0时0分</publish_time></docum

raw_output.raw_text: <search query="中国 金融机构 资管 信托 贷款 网络 关联 产品 余额 资产管理计划" search_time="2026年5月16日12时57分星期六"><document reference_id="<|superscript|>:41"><title>THE CHANGING FACE OF SHADOW BANKING IN CHINA</title><summary>The growth of China’s nonbank financial institutions, which engage heavily in shadow banking¹, has been extraordinary over the past decade. During this period, China’s shadow banking system not only engaged in aggressive regulatory arbitrage but also started to embrace financial innovations and capital market financing against the backdrop of broad financial reforms. Its emergence and transformation are intertwined with a substantial increase in depth and complexity of China’s financial system, which post new regulatory challenges.
